correctness.rationale: The sandwich idempotence equation bounds rank by two. Rank-two idempotents take the two sandwich image labels to a pair of points in the corresponding two disjoint fibers, and independently choose either value on the other n-2 inputs. Distinct constants cannot commute; a constant commutes with a rank-two idempotent exactly at one of its two image points. If two rank-two idempotents commute, equality of product images first identifies their two output points, in the unique fiber order; then the products are the two original maps in opposite order, forcing equality. This establishes subdivision with t copies for every edge. In the unsigned incidence Gram matrix the two within-fiber sum-zero blocks contribute vt and ut; the 2-by-2 quotient contributes nt and 0. The signed pairs of square roots and rank give the stated polynomial even for n=2 or singleton fibers. The spectral radius and graph order recover n and uv. For n>=4 degree separation and the common-neighbor relation recover the base biclique; each fiber of twins can be permuted independently and base automorphisms lift. Independently enumerated all 104 rank-two sandwich maps on n=2,3,4 via /workspace/branches/reproduce_sandwich_independent.py, checking neighbor sets and exact characteristic polynomials. Read the frozen checker and recorded output without running them; the unrestricted result follows from the proof. A checker comment about degree-two vertices must be read with the n>=4 scope of the statement.
